about.title: A new Pearland shop built around CNC machining
text: Our newly constructed Pearland facility features modern CNC machinery, which we use to hold our standard of quality.
We repair slewing ring bearings from all manufacturers, including Rotek, Rothe Erde, Rollix, Kaydon, Avon, Taperex, INA and PSL.
We make or repair large bearings of any type, such as ball, tapered roller, thrust roller and rotary table, and offer expedited repair when time is short.
